purpose: PLANNED REVIEW ONLY: independently authored red fox digitigrade reference, next after the deer quality gate; no asset or runtime family is implemented by this brief.

artDirection.summary: Adult Vulpes vulpes red-phase fox with tapered muzzle, cupped triangular ears, coherent scapular and pelvic anatomy, four articulated load-bearing toes per paw and a long bushy tail. Original fox topology and rig; references and juvenile proportions require review before authoring.
artDirection.negativePrompt: stretched deer, hoof paws, human hands, plantigrade hindlimbs, reversed stifles, floating eyelids or ears, pinched groin, cylindrical tail, toy face, baked directional shadows

visual: Deer reference quality gate passes before fox generation or runtime family expansion begins; all fox deliverables remain planned until produced and reviewed
Species-specific side, front, rear, top and three-quarter reference comparisons approve fox head, shoulder, loin, tail and four-toed paws; retain source credits and reference limitations
Neutral and walking mesh preserves shoulder, groin, abdominal volume and attached facial features; inspect wireframe, head and pad close-ups in neutral and grazing light
Juvenile and bounded adult variation use fox-specific proportions, preserve individual coat identity and pass both-side review; no uniform scale-only juvenile
technical: Actual GLB passes assetctl and Khronos checks and Blender reimport; metres, Y up, Atlas +X forward, explicit UVs and deterministic names
At most 20000 triangles, 3 materials, 48 bones, 4 normalized skin influences per vertex and 16 named morph targets; proposed 47-bone graph includes individual main toes

At most 2 texture sets and dimension 2048; shared decoded RGBA8 allocation including mips at most 48 MiB over ALL maps, preferably basecolor and normal 2048, ORM 1024; metallic zero and no baked directional light
Exported named joint parentage, neutral local transforms and per-target local joint deltas match the authored fox graph; no assumption of the deer 27-bone motion graph

Independent actual connected-skin intersection and full-body deformation tests cover neutral, both limbs, interacting morph extremes and gait phases; retain edge ratios 0.45 to 1.8 and reject crossings or local reversals

Authoring manifest preserves brief/source/tool hashes, seed, source ownership, license state, reference ledger, review outcomes and exact output hashes; use fresh candidate paths without overwriting prior source
runtime: Family-specific motion measures actual skinned pad/toe contacts, all-sole clearance, stance drift, reach limits and measured segment lengths; deterministic forward/backward seeking
Two independently morphed skeleton instances and six nearby animals preserve identity and saved specimen replay; repeated switches dispose resources and memory remains bounded
Record actual desktop CPU/GPU frame cost and shared texture memory; no performance, animation or XR acceptance inferred from schema validation
Only accepted fox source revisions may enter Creature Lab or world defaults; publish requires resolved original asset license, packaged provenance and visual/runtime acceptance

provenance.prompt: PLANNED ONLY: after reference deer acceptance, author an original anatomically grounded red fox with a distinct digitigrade paw rig, connected deformation topology, genuine bounded morphs and preserved source/provenance.
provenance.negativePrompt: deer mesh rescale, imported human mesh, hoof replacement only, thin inverted groin triangles, rigid unarticulated paws

restrictions: Planned review asset only; resolve original asset licensing and visual/runtime acceptance before publication
Linked references retain their individual rights; no source photograph, CT data or mesh is incorporated

provenance.notes: No fox generation, model download, checkpoint, GPU run or runtime family expansion has occurred. Generator fields describe a proposed original Blender workflow, not an available operation or completed run. Credits and rights limitations are in docs/fauna-pawed-reference-plan-2026-10-02.md. Any reused CharacterCreator-derived runtime algorithms retain their separate MIT attribution. Deliverable paths are eventual package targets; future runs write fresh Assets/_assetctl/red-fox-candidate-NNN directories. LODs and headset qualification require later work. Seed is reserved, not a record of execution.

experiments.selectionMetric: Planned: species-specific anatomy, connected topology, both-side pad contact and deformation, coherent morph growth, and measured desktop cost
